statement: Learning a one-step interoceptive transition model from the agent's own sensory transitions supplies action features that permit balanced thermal/food/safety learning where generic relational Sarsa failed.
rationale: The fixed lambda0 learner reliably forages and avoids but misses thermal comfort; increasing thermal reward weight alone did not solve the tradeoff and could return starvation. Generic linear action interactions may poorly represent absolute predicted thermal error. Learn a three-parameter observable transition model, then expose predicted absolute/squared error and action-relative differences to the same reward-trained critic. No hand-coded utility sign or model-based expert actions.
falsification: No full promotion unless the learned-model variant passes every one of six unchanged criteria on all3 training seeds at final1M. A mechanistic partial lead requires temperature.outside improves by>=.05 in>=2/3 seeds versus both paired controls, with hunger<=.35 and no aggregate proximity/contact regression>10%. Base and zero-model should reproduce each other exactly. Model accuracy or scalar reward alone cannot establish behavioral success.

sources.title: Learning to Act by Predicting the Future
sources.sectionsRead: 3 Model,3.1 Training,3.2 Architecture, pp3-5; vector measurements and supervised predictions from own experience
sources.mechanism: Use observed future measurements as dense self-supervision for action-conditioned representations.
sources.limitations: Our model is ridge-initialized3-variable RLS and predicts only one-step normalized temperature; predictions augment an unchanged scalar Sarsa critic. It is not the source's deep multi-horizon DFP architecture or its direct vector-goal control. Local Taylor field approximation, known motor scale1.5 and sensor spacing3 are explicit domain priors. No access to hidden physics parameters, world snapshots, random state or teacher policy.

sources.title: Live thermal-weight-pilot-01
sources.limitations: Repeated pilot seeds guide the question; only new independent confirmation can establish transfer.

protocol.motivation: Original weighted-homeostasis, no altered weights or intrinsic rewards.
protocol.learner: Fixed-normalization lambda0 Sarsa, alpha.03 gamma.97, epsilon1->.05/50k; all variants skip TD updates during first2000 transitions and then perform998000 updates.
protocol.model: Observe bodyBefore,nextFieldCenter,nextBody during2000 warmup steps; fit nextBody=a*bodyBefore+b*observedNextField+c by RLS (initial covariance10000I, zero coefficients). Freeze thereafter, avoiding a nonstationary feature map during TD learning. At decision time approximate nextField only from current five sensors and candidate motor displacement; next observations are targets only during training.
protocol.controls: Base with matched warmup, zero-coefficient frozen predictor, learned predictor. Zero model contributes only zero additional features, so base/zero exact hash equality is expected and is not extra independent evidence. Runner random/untrained/initial frozen included.
protocol.checkpointRule: Final1M only; all100k curves, all evaluation worlds and model coefficients/samples in manifest ControllerState. No best seed/checkpoint selection.
protocol.fullRule: New training/evaluation seeds, preregistered final budget and per-need/per-world confirmation before claiming satisfactory acquisition.
